name: Use Legacy Boot Menu
description: Enables the classic Windows legacy boot menu to make advanced startup options easier to access on some systems, but it may change the modern boot experience and slightly affect startup behavior.

description_i18n.en: Enables the classic Windows legacy boot menu to make advanced startup options easier to access on some systems, but it may change the modern boot experience and slightly affect startup behavior.
description_i18n.de: Aktiviert das klassische Legacy-Startmenü von Windows. Das kann den Zugriff auf erweiterte Startoptionen erleichtern, verändert aber das moderne Boot-Erlebnis und beeinflusst das Startverhalten leicht.
description_i18n.fr: Active l'ancien menu de démarrage classique de Windows pour faciliter l'accès aux options avancées sur certains systèmes, mais cela modifie l'expérience de démarrage et peut légèrement influencer le comportement au démarrage.

warnings.title: Startup behavior change
warnings.message: This tweak updates boot configuration values that affect startup behavior and may alter the modern boot experience

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the boot configuration by setting the BootMenuPolicy value to Legacy via bcdedit
